children: Curaleaf filed with the Alberta Securities Commission to stop Aurora's at‑the‑market share issuances, saying they diluted shareholders and raised Curaleaf's offer cost by over US$11 million.
Filed expedited application with the Alberta Securities Commission to cease Aurora's ATM issuances while Curaleaf's takeover offer is outstanding.
Says Aurora issued ~2.81M shares at an average US$3.04 since Curaleaf's interest, increasing Curaleaf's offer cost by >US$11M.
Alleges ATM program diluted Aurora shareholders ~4.9% since June 2026 and ~10.8% since the program began in Feb 2026.
Requests ASC remedies to protect shareholders' ability to fairly consider Curaleaf's premium offer and halt further ATM issuances.
